content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APS Mumbai
content_sections.text: Log on to the school website at www.apsmumbai.com to download the application form and check other details. Fill out the application form completely with all required details. Prepare a Demand Draft of Rs. 250/- in favour of Army Public School Mumbai payable at Mumbai. Enclose the filled application form along with the Demand Draft. Send the hard copy of the application by post to Army Public School Mumbai, Dr Nanabhoy Moos Road, Opposite- INHS Asvini, Near RC Church, Colaba, Mumbai – 400 005. Ensure the application reaches the school on or before 25 October 2026. Note that applications sent via E-mail will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is APS Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: APS Mumbai Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification issued by Army Public School Mumbai to fill teaching and non-teaching posts on an ad hoc basis for the academic year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APS Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification, and the anticipated vacancies are stated to be tentative and subject to change.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts announced in this notification?
faq.answer: The posts include PGT English, TGT English, Asst PRT (all subjects), Speech Therapist, School Bus Driver, Lower Division Clerk (LDC), and Multi Tasking Staff (Grp D).

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application for APS Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the hard copy of the application is 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for APS Mumbai posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications for all advertised posts are as per CBSE norms for respective posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for APS Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 250/-, payable via Demand Draft in favour of Army Public School Mumbai payable at Mumbai.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply online or via email for APS Mumbai Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted in hard copy via post, and no applications will be accepted via E-mail.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for APS Mumbai posts?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit specified in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify an age limit.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form from the official website at www.apsmumbai.com.
